questions.topic: A complaint and how it is escalated politely
questions.learningObjective: Select the polite complaint phrase for a delayed transport.

stimulus.body: The survey transport is delayed. The biologist must complain politely to the coordinator.

questions.stem: Which phrase complains politely about delayed transport in the survey?

options.text: El transporte se retraso; podriamos ajustar el horario?

questions.explanation: Stating the delay and requesting a schedule adjustment is polite; blaming or overreacting is not.
